description: This file contains database access methods for managing team data in a SQL database, including functions for inserting, updating, retrieving, and counting team records, as well as handling team settings and signup tokens.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: A struct representing the SQL database store with methods for team data management.

methods.name: upsertTeamSignupToken
methods.description: Inserts or updates a team's signup token in the database.

methods.name: upsertTeamSettings
methods.description: Inserts or updates a team's settings in the database.

methods.name: getTeam
methods.description: Retrieves a team by ID from the database, including settings unmarshalling.

methods.name: getTeamsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all teams associated with a user (currently returns all teams).

methods.name: getTeamCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of teams in the database.

methods.name: teamsFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of team models.

methods.name: getAllTeams
methods.description: Retrieves all team records from the database.
